summary: Describes RTP, a protocol for carrying real-time data such as audio and video over unicast or multicast networks. It adds sequencing and timing information so receivers can play media back smoothly, and it comes with a companion control protocol. It was replaced by RFC 3550.

eli5.summary: When you watch a live video, the pieces must arrive in order and on time. This protocol puts a number and a clock reading on each piece so the player can put them back together smoothly.

questions: how does real-time audio and video transport work
